title: Daily Devotional #51
paragraphs: As I read Luke 7 today, I am struck by the faith and humility of the people in this chapter. In the first few verses, we see a Roman centurion who sends Jewish elders to Jesus to ask for his help in healing his servant. The centurion acknowledges Jesus' authority and power, even though he himself is a person of authority. He recognizes that he is not worthy to have Jesus come into his home, but believes that Jesus can heal his servant with just a word. Jesus is amazed by the centurion's faith and says that he has not found such faith even among the people of Israel.

Lord, help me to have faith like the centurion. Help me to recognize your authority and power, and to trust that you can do anything, even with just a word. Help me to have humility like the centurion, recognizing that I am not worthy of your grace and mercy, but trusting in them anyway.

Later in the chapter, we see a woman who is known to be a sinner come into the house where Jesus is dining. She weeps at Jesus' feet and anoints them with oil, kissing them and wiping them with her hair. The Pharisee who invited Jesus into his home is scandalized by this display, but Jesus tells him that the woman's sins, which are many, have been forgiven because of her great love.

Lord, help me to love you like this woman did. Help me to be so grateful for your forgiveness that I am willing to humble myself before you and show my love in tangible ways. Help me to recognize that my sins, which are many, have been forgiven through your great love and sacrifice.
Finally, we see Jesus raise a young man from the dead in the town of Nain. The people who witness this miracle are filled with awe and glorify God, recognizing that Jesus is a prophet sent from God.

Lord, help me to be filled with awe and wonder at your power and glory. Help me to recognize that you are not just a prophet, but the Son of God, who came to save us from our sins. Help me to glorify you in all that I do, and to share your love and grace with others.
Thank you for the lessons and examples of faith, humility, and love that we see in Luke 7. Help me to apply these truths to my own life and to grow closer to you each day. Amen.
